build_data_loader: build a PyTorch data loader from params dict specifying dataset type, transforms, and loader config
parse_transform_ImageJitter: parse an ImageJitter transform using jitter_params from the transform_params dictionary
parse_transform_Crop: parse a RandomSizedCrop or CenterCrop transform using the image_size parameter
parse_transform_Normalize: parse a Normalize transform using mean and std values from transform_params
review_dataset_dict: review the dataset_dict mapping dataset names like CIFAR10 and ImageFolder to torchvision dataset classes
